scope: Researcher-defined two-product non-fungible extension carried through the full Op1-Op13 DES. It is not a thesis-native MFSC product-mix estimate.

garrido_alignment.question_1: Test whether retained state and a learning/search mechanism improve repeated DES configuration selection.
garrido_alignment.question_2: Close the loop from simulation decision variables to SCRES metric and back to the next configuration.

physical_extension.shared_capacity: fixed downstream dispatch entitlement and product-specific inventory
physical_extension.actions: number of the next three weekly batch targets assigned to P_C: 0,1,2,3

estimand.definition: For each tape, the maximum ret_excel_full_ledger among calendars satisfying all per-tape guardrails minus the comparator calendar's ret_excel_full_ledger, averaged over tapes.

operations.terminal_stock: reported; flag if candidate exceeds comparator by >5% of generated ration demand without a primary improvement

guardrails.clipped_endpoint: secondary descriptive only; never used alone for selection
guardrails.ret_thesis: secondary robustness endpoint; never replaces the primary

sesoi.interpretation: one percentage point of safe full-ledger resilience
sesoi.validation_rule: one-sided simultaneous LCB95 > 0.01 on the predeclared primary comparison
sesoi.development_rule: mean safe HPI > 0.015 and at least 17 favorable tapes; descriptive only

frozen_incumbent.source: development block best static calendar in parent Program O full-DES contract

comparators.in_sample_static_incumbent: argmax of the 65536 static calendars within each block and profile; selection is descriptive and never substituted for the frozen comparison

controls.fungible_placebo: complete_substitution=true; outcome arrays must be bit-identical and H_PI=0; product-label inventory partitions are reported but are not outcome nulls
controls.uninformed_placebo: frozen open-loop incumbent; no tape-specific or state-conditioned calendar

adjudication.development_pass: primary mean safe HPI > 0.015, all physical/null/conservation gates pass, and no guardrail fails
adjudication.validation_pass: primary simultaneous one-sided LCB95 > 0.01, all physical/null/conservation gates pass, secondary endpoints do not reverse the operational conclusion
adjudication.stop: any guardrail, fungible null, conservation, parity, custody, or metric-definition failure
adjudication.learner_authorization: false until the validation rule passes; H_PI is a necessary headroom gate, not evidence that RL is superior

claim_boundary: No claim that the two-product extension is Garrido's real product mix
No replacement of the Garrido 2024 outer-loop answer
No fresh-seed confirmation from this retrospective reanalysis
